name: DeLaurenti House Pate
description: Our ultra smooth House Pate is back with a new recipe! A house favorite for years! Serve with cornichons and a crusty Macrina baguette. Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: Fabrique & Delice Duck Mousse
tagline: Silky mousse made with fresh duck livers marinated in port
description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Duck Mousse is buttery and smooth in texture, and ultra-rich in flavor. Made with fresh duck livers marinated in port wine, it is perfect enjoyed with a traditional French baguette and cornichons.

name: Fabrique & Delice Pate de Campagne
tagline: Country-style pork pate with black pepper
description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Pate de Campagne is a coarsely ground country-style pate liberally seasoned with black pepper. It has a great rustic texture and a rich, meaty flavor. Fantastic served with a crusty baguette, pickled vegetables and whatever wine you enjoy.

name: Henaff Pork Liver Confit with Black Pepper, 90g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives. This pork liver confit is seasoned with cognac, black peppercorn, salt and spices.

name: Henaff Pork Liver Pate, 130g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives.

name: Henaff Pork Pate de Campagne, 130g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives. The recipe, originating from the village of Brenton, includes pork neck, garlic, and onion for a unique combination of flavors.

name: Henaff Pork Pate, 153g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives. This is their flagship Pate that has been around for the long haul. Still a favorite after all these years!

name: Rillettes de Gascogne (Duck)
description: Le Bec Fin has been crafting traditional charcuterie since 1999 by using finest cuts of all natural meats, world's best spices and fresh vegetables - the result is some of the most delicious artisanal charcuterie you'll find. Their Rillettes de Gascogne are made by simmering shredded duck meat in duck fat. Add some grainy mustard, cornichons, crusty baguette, and you will have a perfect spread!

name: Rougie Duck & Pork Pate with Orange, 80g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this smooth pate is blended to perfection and doused with a liberal dose of refreshing orange liquor. Serve slightly chilled with a crusty baguette, cheese and a glass of Sauternes!

name: Rougie Duck Foie Gras, 80g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this foie gras is buttery, smooth, and ultra-rich. To fully enjoy its full flavor, keep things simple. Warm up a knife in hot water and cut half-inch-thick slices. Place the slices on toasted baguette and add fleur de sel and black pepper to taste. Pour a glass of Sauternes and enjoy!

name: Rougie Duck Rillettes, 80g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Similar to pate, these tasty rillettes are prepared with duck meat, white wine and herbs. Fully cooked and ready to eat, serve slightly chilled with a crusty baguette, cheese and a glass of Sauternes!

name: Rougie Foie Gras Torchon, 3.25oz
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this foie gras is buttery, smooth, and ultra-rich. To fully enjoy it's full flavor, keep things simple. Warm up a knife in hot water and cut half inch thick slices. Place the slices on toasted baguette and add fleur de sel and black pepper to taste. Pour a glass of Sauternes and enjoy!

name: Rougie Mousse Royale
description: Rougie selects only the best foie gras of 100% corn-fed duck liver. This 100% whole duck foie gras parfait makes for a completely ready-to-eat delicacy. Rougie prepares this delicate, melting foie gras mousse through the processing of high-quality lobes of Duck Foie Gras with milk cream, egg foam, a drop of Port Wine, and spices. The stunningly delicate texture and unique flavor allows it to be used as an ideal ingredient for salads, sandwiches, and as a stand-alone dish.

name: Truffle Mousse
tagline: Chicken liver mousse with black truffle
description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Truffle Mousse is silky smooth in texture and ultra-rich in flavor. Made with creamy chicken livers, truffles and marinated porcini mushrooms in sherry, it is perfect with a traditional French baguette and cornichons.
